class.name: HTMLCustomEvent
class.brief_description: An event that carries a script-defined payload.
class.description: Use [HTMLCustomEvent] for application-level events. Assign [member detail] before dispatching; listeners read it to receive structured data. Only [Dictionary] payloads are supported, and the payload is not copied, so listeners share the dispatched value. Assignment is ignored while the event is being dispatched.

members.member: The custom payload delivered to listeners.
